Tess (content): Quick kickoff: tiny OSS refkit "Compact" — one-command quickstart, short launch post, a 20-min demo webinar, and a benchmark highlight. Low-friction.
Ravi (growth): Good. 3-week runway, gated webinar (replay gated), minimal form: email + deployment_interest. Route enterprise=yes to SDRs.
Hana (devrel): I'll author README + Docker quickstart. Snippet for landing:
```
docker run --rm -p8080:8080 redwood/compact:latest
curl -X POST localhost:8080/generate -d '{"prompt":"Explain KV cache"}'
```
Luka (design): I'll make a small hero GIF and two social tiles. Need final headline options A/B.
Tess (content): Headline A: "Compact: run a refkit in 60s" B: "Measure inference perf in minutes". I'll draft a short blog and benchmark mini-post.
Ivy (analytics): UTMs: utm_source=compact_refkit, utm_campaign=compact_q3. Track quickstart_run and bench_submit. Add hidden original_source field for replay dedupe.
deploy-bot: deploy_notice: staging landing deployed to https://staging.redwood.ai/compact at 2024-07-05T12:00:00Z
Ravi (growth): Promo plan: community + X + small LinkedIn. Add metric hook in social (e.g., "see 2x lower tail latency with cache").
Hana (devrel): I'll add a Colab and a quick benchmark script; will publish CSV for reproducibility.
Tess (content): Owners: blog=Tess, landing=Ravi, repo=Hana, design=Luka, tracking=Ivy. Check-in Friday 10am PT.
